name: smwmusic-the-legend-of-zelda-twilight-princess-faron-woods
title: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess - Faron Woods
description:
The soothing music which plays in the Faron Woods of Twilight Princess (assuming it isn't submerged by twilight, that is).

Good for forests, though it can also be similarly used for ruins.

This has been made using ALttP samples with (what I assume to be) similar limitations (i.e. same ADSR, similar echo values).
